messages:
deploy-bot: Config-only deploy scheduled by @kevin for change window 2024-06-18 22:30-23:00 UTC. Canary -> 1% for 15m then ramp if metrics pass. Changes: routing.weight +10% (region-eu), tinybatch.max_tokens 8->4, request.timeout_ms 12000->10000, kvcache.ttl 45s->30s. No model change. Rollback policy: auto-unpin + revert if error_rate_5m > 0.2% or p99 latency > baseline * 1.3.
ashley: Confirming no tenant-exclude? some prepaid tenants are fragile today.
kevin: Yes — excluding prepaid tenants via tenant.exclude = ['prepaid-*'] in rollout. Also pin routing to v2.3.1 for audit.
samir: Obs: tinybatch reduction ups request count, watch tokens/sec and cost delta.
ellie: Can we gate ramping? don't go above 5% until p50 stable for 10m.
oncall-dan: I'll monitor alerts and be on-call during window, will page if error spikes.
ashley: deploy-bot, attach the exact patch so we can audit.
deploy-bot: Here's the patch snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  weight_adjust: +10%
  pinned_version: v2.3.1
batching:
  tinybatch_max_tokens: 4
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 10000
kv_cache:
  ttl_seconds: 30
rollout:
  canary_percent: 1
  canary_duration_mins: 15
  ramp_to_percent: 10
  ramp_checks: p50<120ms & err_rate<0.1%
```
Applied as config-only patch: cfg-20240618-routing-batch-timeout-01.
kevin: Note gate metrics: p50/p95/p99 and 5m error rate. Add `no_canary_burst` flag to avoid tenant spike during ramp.
samir: :thumbsup: I'll run a quick synthetic for long chat prompts to watch gen latency.
ellie: If anything looks sketchy, manual rollback steps: 1) deploy-bot revert cfg-20240618-routing-batch-timeout-01 2) unpin routing version 3) open #incidents and escalate.
ashley: Alert thresholds: error_rate_5m > 0.2% OR p99 > baseline * 1.3. Baseline = last 24h. Also watch OOMs and kvmisses.
oncall-dan: Creating short-lived dashboard and alerts now (will post link).
kevin: Starting canary at 22:30 UTC. If green at 22:45 we ramp to 5% hold 10m then 10% at 22:55. If gate fails we stop and revert.
deploy-bot: Canary started: cfg-20240618-routing-batch-timeout-01 deployed to 1% at 1742156789. Status: rolling. Logs: /deploy/logs/1742156789. Will post updates here.
ashley: Watching. :eyes: 
deploy-bot: Update at 22:37 UTC: detected p99 latency +40% in eu-west and a small error bump. Triggering canary halt. Per policy we will rollback the eu routing weight change only (region-eu), keep batching and timeouts global. Holding canary at 0.5% for stability checks.
kevin: Good call, do partial rollback of eu-weight, then try a softer +4% instead of +10% once stable.
samir: Logs show KV-cache cold spikes in eu during long-chat sessions — might be interaction with tinybatch. I'll run a focused repro.
ellie: Filing follow-up INF ticket INF-4623 and will add notes to post-release checklist.
deploy-bot: Partial rollback completed at 1742156812. Eu routing weight reverted; canary remains at 1% with eu-weight reverted. Status: monitoring.
ashley: :thumbsup: documenting in release notes: partial rollback of eu-weight, batching/timeouts kept. Will prepare a short post-deploy writeup for weeknote.
